decisions.reason: The offer of help when the client is stuck applies specifically to the KDP keyword-entry and upload process; it does not resolve or change the paperback cover requirements.

The source adds process support to the distinct KDP submission requirement but does not change the existing general guidance about publication readiness, front matter, back matter, or other publishing needs.
Assistance when the client becomes stuck during KDP submission does not alter the manuscript editing objective or any approved editorial rewrite.
